protocol: 5 outer and 3 inner StratifiedGroupKFold; session filename blocks, seed 42; one coordinate pass over 0.25/0.5/1/2. Bound internal search to 150 images/class in each fitting and validation partition; outer training and evaluation use all usable images. Choose inner mean macro-F1 then accuracy. Outer validation never used to select weights. Angle imputation/scaling fitted on inner training partitions and refitted on outer training partition.
limitations: Same public dataset source as Shin ASL Alphabet experiment, not the exact published split, detector or a replication of published scores. Filename blocks are not verified subjects. Fixed categorical thresholds/Excel proposals came from separate Roboflow development data; no Kaggle-fold threshold tuning. Only letter classes A-Z. The provided 26 test photos duplicated training pixels and were excluded; no independent final test. Coordinate search is bounded and not exhaustive. Current fixed SVM C/gamma not jointly tuned.
